causes.label: A fuse in your home may be blown or the circuit breaker tripped.
remedies: Replace fuse or reset circuit breaker.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 42: "A fuse in your home may be blown or the circuit breaker tripped."

causes.label: Power surge.
remedies: Unplug the microwave oven, then plug it back in.

causes.label: Plug not fully inserted into wall outlet.
remedies: Make sure the 3-prong plug on the oven is fully inserted into wall outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 42: "Plug not fully inserted into wall outlet."

symptoms.symptom: Floor of the oven is warm, even when the oven has not been used

causes.label: Heat from the cooktop light may make the oven floor get warm.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 42: "Heat from the cooktop light may make the oven floor get warm."

causes.label: The control has been locked.
remedies: Press and hold CLEAR/OFF for about 3 seconds to unlock the control.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 42: "The control has been locked."

symptoms.symptom: You hear an unusual, low-tone beep

causes.label: You have tried to start the Reminder without a valid time of day.
remedies: Start over and enter a valid time of day.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 42: "You have tried to start the Reminder without a valid time of day."

causes.label: When using a Sensor feature, the door was opened before steam could be detected.
remedies: Do not open door until steam is sensed and time is shown counting down on display.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 42: "When using a Sensor feature, the door was opened before steam could be detected."

causes.label: Steam not detected in maximum amount of time.
remedies: Use Time Cook to heat for more time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 42: "Steam not detected in maximum amount of time."

symptoms.symptom: Food amount too large for Sensor Reheat

causes.label: Sensor Reheat is for single servings of recommended foods.
remedies: Use Time Cook for large amounts of food.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 42: "Sensor Reheat is for single servings of recommended foods."

symptoms.symptom: “BAD PROBE” or “PLEASE INSERT PROBE” appears on display

causes.label: Probe has been forgotten or may not be inserted properly into oven outlet.
remedies: Insert the probe properly into the oven wall outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 42: "Probe has been forgotten or may not be inserted properly into oven outlet."

causes.label: The probe is defective.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 42: "The probe is defective."
